title: V4-3: Pure policy evaluator and structured rejects
scope: Pure read-only policy evaluation layer: evaluate_policy returning PolicyDecision, sender_filter, same-domain routing, default behavior, cosign_required; preflight/apply alignment; stable E_POLICY_* reject codes from RFC 14

symbols.name: PolicyDecision
symbols.notes: V4-3 new enum: Allow, Reject(PolicyRejectCode), Redirect(AccountId) for pure evaluator output

symbols.name: PolicyRejectCode
symbols.notes: Stable codes mapping to RFC 14: SenderFiltered, RoutingDenied, MissingCosign, AccountFinalized, RescueRequired, EmergencyCosignRequired, DefaultDeny

symbols.name: evaluate_policy
symbols.notes: Pure fn: evaluate_policy(tx, sender_account, recipient_account_opt) -> PolicyDecision; no state mutation, no IO, deterministic

symbols.name: ReadOnlyState
symbols.notes: Minimal read-only view for evaluator: account lookups without mutation capability

symbols.name: PolicyEvaluator
symbols.notes: Optional struct holding policy evaluation context: sender domain, sender policies, recipient policies

symbols.name: enforce_sender_filter
symbols.notes: Checks if sender matches allowed senders list when SenderFilter policy active

symbols.name: enforce_same_domain_routing
symbols.notes: Rejects cross-domain transfers when RoutingSameDomainOnly policy active

symbols.name: enforce_cosign_required
symbols.notes: Validates cosign envelope when CosignRequired policy active for selected actions

symbols.name: check_finalized_account
symbols.notes: Returns PolicyAccountFinalized for non-allowed actions on finalized accounts; scaffold for V4-4 emergency routing

symbols.name: State::apply_tx_with_ctx
symbols.notes: Extend match arms to call evaluate_policy before state mutation; apply PolicyDecision; maintain no-mutation-on-reject guarantee

symbols.name: apply_policy_action
symbols.notes: V4-2 existing; handles SetPolicy/ActivatePolicy/DeactivatePolicy; remains unchanged in V4-3

symbols.name: TxError
symbols.notes: V4-2 already has all policy errors: PolicySchemaInvalid, PolicyNotInstalled, PolicyNotActive, PolicyDenied, PolicyMissingCosign, PolicyRescueRequired, PolicyEmergencyCosignRequired, PolicyAccountFinalized, PolicyIrreversible

symbols.name: PolicyKind::is_reversible
symbols.notes: Returns false for RoutingEmergencyRedirect (irreversible); used in deactivate validation

symbols.name: PolicyKind::bit
symbols.notes: u16 bitset position for account active_policies/dormant_policies; max 16 policies per account

symbols.name: Account::active_policies
symbols.notes: u16 bitset; checked by evaluate_policy for active policy enforcement

symbols.name: Account::dormant_policies
symbols.notes: u16 bitset; not checked by evaluator, used for activation lifecycle

symbols.name: Account::finalized
symbols.notes: bool flag; V4-3 returns PolicyAccountFinalized error for unauthorized actions; V4-4 will add emergency routing redirect logic

symbols.name: Account::rescue_address
symbols.notes: Optional AccountId; V4-3 validates presence for emergency policy activation; V4-4 will use for redirect routing

symbols.name: Cosignature
symbols.notes: V4-2 existing; signer_pk, role (Rescue/Organization/Witness), signature; used by cosign_required policy

symbols.name: SignedTx::cosigns
symbols.notes: Vec<Cosignature>; V4-3 evaluator validates cosign signatures and roles against policies

symbols.name: enforce_local_tx_guards
symbols.notes: pwmd preflight guards; V4-3 must align with State::evaluate_policy verdicts for consistency

symbols.name: tx_err_wire
symbols.notes: Maps TxError to stable RFC 14 codes; V4-3 policy errors already mapped: E_POLICY_*

symbols.name: tx_reject_json
symbols.notes: Builds RFC 14 compliant JSON reject; V4-3 uses existing function unchanged

symbols.name: v1_tx
symbols.notes: HTTP handler; V4-3 must ensure preflight (precheck_apply_with_ctx) and apply use same evaluate_policy logic

symbols.name: SnapshotAccountV2::active_policies
symbols.notes: u16 wire format; snapshot already supports policy fields from V4-2

symbols.name: SnapshotAccountV2::finalized
symbols.notes: bool wire format; persists finalized state across restarts

digest: V4-3 implements the pure read-only policy evaluation layer on top of V4-2 data model. The core addition is `evaluate_policy(tx, &ReadOnlyState) -> PolicyDecision` - a deterministic, side-effect-free function that returns Allow, Reject(code), or Redirect(rescue_address). Key policies enforced: sender_filter (whitelist-based), same-domain routing restriction (blocks cross-domain TRANSFER when RoutingSameDomainOnly active), default_behavior (deny/allow), and cosign_required (validates embedded cosign signatures for sensitive actions). The evaluator runs in both preflight (pwmd) and apply (State::apply_tx_with_ctx) paths with identical verdicts, ensuring alignment per RFC 14. Structured rejects use stable E_POLICY_* codes already defined in TxError and mapped in tx_err_wire. Account finalized flag blocks ordinary operations but V4-3 does NOT implement emergency routing balance redirection - that behavior is reserved for V4-4 with proper rescue cosign validation. No VM, no DSL, no callbacks, no dynamic dispatch - just bounded enum-based policy matching.

risks.description: Preflight/apply misalignment: pwmd precheck and state apply return different verdicts for same input
risks.mitigation: Implement single evaluate_policy function used by both paths; add explicit test matrix covering all policy kinds in both preflight and apply contexts

risks.description: Evaluator mutation side effects: policy evaluation accidentally mutates account state
risks.mitigation: ReadOnlyState view restricts API to immutable references only; evaluate_policy returns Decision without &mut State

risks.description: Cosign verification bypass: cosign_required policy not properly validating embedded cosignatures
risks.mitigation: Reuse Tx::verify_sig pattern; validate cosign signer matches policy role; reject unknown cosign roles

risks.description: Sender filter list storage: no on-chain list structure exists for sender_filter policy
risks.mitigation: V4-3 implements minimal sender_filter as single allowed sender stored in account metadata; multi-sender list deferred to V5

risks.description: Emergency routing scope creep: implementing balance redirection in V4-3 instead of V4-4
risks.mitigation: Explicit boundary: evaluate_policy returns Redirect decision but apply path treats it as Reject in V4-3; V4-4 will implement actual routing

risks.description: Default behavior ambiguity: DefaultBehavior policy semantics unclear for tx types not explicitly covered
risks.mitigation: DefaultBehavior = Allow permits all non-explicitly-forbidden actions; DefaultBehavior = Deny rejects all non-explicitly-permitted actions; document in RFC 6

suggested_acceptance_tests: evaluate_policy returns Allow for Transfer with no active policies
evaluate_policy returns Reject(SenderFiltered) for Transfer when SenderFilter active and sender not in list
evaluate_policy returns Reject(RoutingDenied) for cross-domain Transfer when RoutingSameDomainOnly active
evaluate_policy returns Reject(MissingCosign) for sensitive action when CosignRequired active and no valid cosign
evaluate_policy returns same verdict for identical input in preflight and apply paths (determinism)
apply_tx_with_ctx does not mutate state when evaluate_policy returns Reject
preflight in pwmd returns same E_POLICY_* error code as apply for same tx and pre-state
finalized account returns PolicyAccountFinalized for Transfer, Stake, Unstake attempts
cosign_required policy validates cosignature signer_pk matches expected rescue/organization role
snapshot roundtrip preserves active_policies bitset and finalized flag deterministically
State::precheck_apply_with_ctx and State::apply_tx_with_ctx show identical policy reject behavior
tx_err_wire maps PolicyRejectCode to correct RFC 14 E_POLICY_* stable codes

notes.v4_3_boundary: DO NOT implement emergency routing balance redirection or rescue_address balance finalization - these are V4-4 scope. V4-3 only returns PolicyDecision::Redirect as Reject scaffolding.
notes.v4_4_prep: PolicyDecision::Redirect(rescue_address) enum variant reserved for V4-4; V4-3 may define but not implement the actual balance routing in apply path.
